mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cluster_node (id, cluster_id, name, internal_ip, cpu_cores, memory_bytes, gpu_count, status, labels_json, taints_json, last_sync_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{clusterId}, #{name}, #{internalIp}, #{cpuCores}, #{memoryBytes}, #{gpuCount}, #{status}, #{labelsJson}, #{taintsJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE cluster_node SET internal_ip = #{internalIp}, cpu_cores = #{cpuCores}, memory_bytes = #{memoryBytes}, gpu_count = #{gpuCount}, status = #{status}, labels_json = #{labelsJson}, taints_json = #{taintsJson}, last_sync_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cluster_node WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND name = #{name}
mapper.update: UPDATE cluster_node SET resource_pool_id = #{poolId}, compute_spec_id = #{computeSpecId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND resource_pool_id IS NULL AND compute_spec_id IS NULL
UPDATE cluster_node SET resource_pool_id = NULL, compute_spec_id = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE compute_spec_id = #{computeSpecId}
